par-p01.claim: Consciousness — world's form yet beyond it, throbbing as supreme power — is venerated as the Lord's heart.
par-p01.conclusion: Immanence and transcendence predicated together before any exposition; the paradox is the program.
par-p01.inference: Visvatmika + taduttirna held in one breath; sphuranti already names the pulse; paradi promises the scale.
par-p01.lore: Pradipaka title gloss; Hareesh authorship wrinkle logged.
par-p01.question: What consciousness is venerated, and under which form?
par-p01.speaker: Ksemaraja, venerating voice
unresolved_terms: Authorship ascription disputed in one modern source; edition followed

par-p02.claim: The Lord is light-selfed; light is awareness-natured — the unmade-I flash through forming, shining, withdrawing.
par-p02.conclusion: Calm-brahman bare light refused; awareness-less shining falls inert, sun-proved.
par-p02.inference: Nanu staged and answered by specification (twofold, three-functioned); akrtrima anti-constructivist; yadi-consequence sealed by solar parity.
par-p02.lore: Lakshmanjoo/Hughes entrance frame; santabrahmavadin = Advaitin target.
par-p02.next_pressure: Trumpet awareness under its ten scriptural names (passage 3).
par-p02.question: Bare shining, or shining that knows its shining?
par-p02.speaker: Ksemaraja + objector (nanu)

par-p03.claim: One awareness, ten scriptural names — each defined by its distinct work.
par-p03.conclusion: The canon's many tongues speak one referent; mineness (mama sphurati) blocks universal flash.
par-p03.inference: List then ten justifications; sarvasarvajjnata reductio guards sphuratta.
par-p03.lore: agamabhasa many-tongues claim; Pradipaka Para-scale behind usages.
par-p03.question: Is vimarsa one coinage or the canon's constant theme?
par-p03.speaker: Ksemaraja, expounding voice

par-p04.claim: He throbs and shines as siva-to-earth world; this is His doership and the world's aliveness; effecthood is dependent-shining; He is never veiled.
par-p04.conclusion: Two objections (difference-qua-effect; veiling-qua-likeness) answered; shining-talk replaces causation-talk.
par-p04.inference: Sphurati+prakasate prove karttrtva+ajadatva at once; nanu1 answered by etadadhina; nanu2 by pratyuta self-destroying veil.
par-p04.lore: Erchenkov gnostic-appendix reading; staged nanu spine.
par-p04.question: Does He shine as the world, and can anything veil Him?
par-p04.speaker: Ksemaraja + objector (two nanu)

par-p05.claim: The already-proved Lord needs no proof; the asker refutes himself; proof serves only maya-dealings; beyond proofs' life is the Life, the Lord.
par-p05.conclusion: Reasoning retired without being refuted; proof demoted to body-blue-pleasure knowables.
par-p05.inference: Purvasiddha blocks operation; two questions self-answer via svasamvedana; abhinava-abhasa rest argument demotes pramana; taduktam seals.
par-p05.next_pressure: Ground I-ness in word-mass; list the thirty-six (passage 6).
par-p05.question: What work is left for proof?
par-p05.speaker: Ksemaraja, proving voice

par-p06.claim: Word-mass full-I-grasping is His essence; hence He Himself is the thirty-sixfold expanse.
par-p06.conclusion: Tattva defined (undivided classing divided), then thirty-six names in order; marks promised for later.
par-p06.inference: Sabdarasi a-to-ha grounds purnahanta; mountain/earth river/water exhibit the definition; list bare.
par-p06.lore: Pradipaka Sattrimsat-sandoha pointer; Tattvic Chart map.
par-p06.next_pressure: Mark each level; fall and return (passage 7).
par-p06.question: How is pure I-grasping at once thirty-six levels?
par-p06.speaker: Ksemaraja, enumerating voice

par-p07.claim: Levels dim by I/this faintness to person; person deeming deeds binders wanders; magician-immune; recognition-freed while bodied, Siva at fall; uncontracted powers take five sheaths (robbed-king logic).
par-p07.conclusion: Whole fall and return in one movement; delusion His, never His.
par-p07.inference: Dhyamala grades; indrajala immunizes; vidyabhijnapita lifts to ciddhana; rajna analogy justifies kaladi dealing.
par-p07.lore: Descent ladder; magician + robbed-king analogies kept.
par-p07.next_pressure: Define each sheath and unfold nature (passage 8).
par-p07.question: How do levels dim, bind, and unbind?
par-p07.speaker: Ksemaraja, narrating voice

par-p08.claim: Each sheath littles one glory; the five are one veil over full consciousness; nature balances gunas; organ, senses, subtles, elements unfold by function.
par-p08.conclusion: Deprivation then unfolding, each stop defined; time defined sharpest (was-am-will cutting).
par-p08.inference: Yaya-clauses deprive; etat pancakam unifies veil; samyavastha roots; indriya/tanmatra/bhuta functional.
par-p08.question: What does each sheath take, and what unfolds?
par-p08.speaker: Ksemaraja, defining voice

par-p09.claim: The world stands inside the heart-seed (banyan, peacock-egg, clay, ghee proved); letters involute (sa/31/au); the seed double-formed is Paramasiva; knower initiated without oblation, living-freed, Siva at death.
par-p09.conclusion: Whole work lands in one knower; hymn ends in abiding.
par-p09.inference: Similes then amnaya verse; pot/ghee prove sat; phonemics involute 36 into aham-visarga; phala threefold.
par-p09.next_pressure: None — colophon closes; KSTS paratext excluded.
par-p09.question: Where do the thirty-six stand, and what befalls the knower?
par-p09.speaker: Ksemaraja, sealing voice
